offering_description.value: Provides digital media measurement and verification software that helps advertisers check ad viewability, brand safety, fraud and campaign quality. Sold mainly to brands, agencies and publishers, delivered as an online software platform with analytics.

primary_products.value: ad verification software; brand safety tools; viewability measurement; ad fraud detection; campaign analytics dashboards

primary_services.value: campaign measurement reporting; analytics consulting; data integration support

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, ad agencies, digital publishers, social and video platforms

end_markets.value: digital advertising; media and publishing; retail; consumer goods; financial services

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual platform fees for measurement and verification software; transaction or usage fees: fees based on the number of ad impressions measured

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: measurement platform sold to advertisers, agencies and publishers; service provider: verification and analytics services for ad campaigns, sold to brands and agencies

geography_served.value: global: Operates in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: digital ad measurement and verification as its single core product line

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to brands, agencies and publishers; partners / resellers: integrations with ad platforms, demand-side platforms and ad servers; online: software delivered through online platform and tag-based integrations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and consumer data rules such as GDPR and CCPA apply to its data collection
